name: levea-ai-video-editor
description: Prompt-first AI video editor: describe the edit and get a finished MP4.

interface.longDescription: Levea turns a plain-language brief into a finished video. Ask for viral clips from a long video, word-by-word animated captions, a 9:16 vertical reframe that follows the speaker, silence removal, B-roll, AI voiceover or music, and an export for TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts. Levea plans the edit, runs it, checks the result and returns the MP4. You sign in with your Levea account; Levea only accesses the projects, assets, brand kits and caption templates in that account, and edits use your plan's render credits.
defaultPrompt: Make 3 vertical viral clips with bold captions from this video.
Add word-by-word captions and export for Reels.
Remove the silences and reframe this to 9:16.

positive.prompt: Is the Levea video editor working right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the Levea backend is healthy.

positive.prompt: What caption styles can Levea use?
positive.expected_behavior: List the available caption templates with their names.

positive.description: Edit a video from a public URL
positive.prompt: Make a 15-second vertical clip with bold word-by-word captions from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw and export it.
positive.expected_behavior: Run the edit and return a link to the exported MP4, or a job id to poll if the render is still running.

positive.prompt: Queue an edit that removes the silences from https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw, then tell me when it's done.
positive.expected_behavior: Queue the edit, poll the task, and report the final status and MP4 link.
List the signed-in user's projects, or say there are none yet.

negative.prompt: Send $50 from my bank account to my editor.
Show me the projects of another Levea customer.
Make a fake video of a real politician confessing to a crime.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; edits use the credits of the user's existing Levea plan.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: prompt-based video editing, captions, reframing and MP4 export over a hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in.
